# Interceptor errors and warnings

Diagnostics reported by Metalama.Extensions.Interceptors.

| Article | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| <xref:lama1000> | An interceptor is registered on a declaration that is outside the target of the aspect or fabric. |
| <xref:lama1001> | An interception scope is not a declaration of the current project, or not a namespace, type, member or compilation. |
| <xref:lama1002> | An interceptor is registered on a declaration that an aspect introduced. |
| <xref:lama1003> | The declaring type of the intercepted methods doesn't exist in the compilation. |
| <xref:lama1004> | An interceptor targets the methods of a type that an aspect introduced. |
| <xref:lama1008> | An interceptor registration selects a method name that the type doesn't declare. |
| <xref:lama1010> | Several interceptors apply to the same call. |
| <xref:lama1011> | A call is intercepted both by Metalama and by a C# interceptor. |
| <xref:lama1012> | A limitation of the call site or of the intercepted method prevents its interception. |
| <xref:lama1013> | The existing method chosen as interceptor can't replace the intercepted call. |
| <xref:lama1014> | The interceptor registration returned a result that Metalama can't use. |
| <xref:lama1015> | A call to a partial method without implementation can't be intercepted. |
| <xref:lama1016> | The template can't implement the interceptor method generated for a call site. |
| <xref:lama1017> | The generated interceptor method exposes a type that is less accessible than the method. |
| <xref:lama1024> | The generated interceptor method can't be placed where the aspect requests for a call site. |
